difficulty_reason: With the prescribed eikonal phases supplied, the authored proof still has to expand a matrix-valued lattice Fourier-integral commutator and control every frequency derivative of the remainder at the precise min(1+rho,2) decay. It performs a weighted Taylor expansion uniform in arbitrarily large lattice shifts, exploiting rapid kernel decay, then combines the long-range scalar-channel cancellation with the differentiated angular cutoff to identify the explicit leading outgoing/incoming term. The complete local modifier boundedness, weighted composition and projector-commutator argument is also retained; these lattice/matrix remainder and channel-cancellation mechanisms exceed ordinary qualification spectral theory, without claiming to construct a new eikonal solution.
